format_notes: All files 1080x1920 (9:16), H.264 High + AAC 48kHz stereo, 30fps, moov atom at front (faststart).
audio_notes: Promo files keep their narrated mix; other clips use the original procedural Petalspire music track (no third-party samples).

videos.description: Full 30s narrated promo: garden path and glowing Moonflower, seed sprouting into a golden bloom, green tin opening to a Petalspire card pack, seed pods harvested into a basket, the Garden Market 'Tinctures & Dried Herbs' stall, trading cards, and the Petalspire logo end card 'Grow your world. Trade the rare. Bloom together. Coming soon to iPhone'.
videos.caption_idea: Step into Petalspire 🌸 Plant, harvest, open card packs and trade rare blooms with friends. Coming soon to iPhone. #cozygames #gardengame
